diag-n1-100k.interpretation: All times are ms. GPU node times are from synchronizing diagnostics, not throughput runs. host_register_ms is inside host_bind_ms and host_prepare_ms. host_sync_ms is inside compute_ms. Spill copy walls are inside upload/readback. Cache publication includes named cache writes; unnamed writes remain other GPU. Spill bytes count the native BF16 hidden/F32 pre contract and witnessed compact widths, excluding common seed/ID mirrors. The first layer snapshot also contains seed operations. Never add overlapping clocks.
